shadows.name: return-report
shadows.purpose: A low lift for the report the user returns to.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Action feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

narrative.overview: Reclaim attention through a process of defined outcomes, delegated work and inspectable proof. Cool neutrals carry the page; restrained blue identifies action and selection.

rules.name: Reading first
rules.body: Keep large fields neutral and reserve color for interaction and meaningful states.

dos: Connect maps, tasks, checks and reports to the relief of stepping away.
donts: Do not present a saved recording as live agent or host execution.
